title: Medical Legal P&S Report Reviewer - Workers' Compensation
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Virtual Med-Legal P&S Report Reviewer to support a physician specializing in California Workers’ Compensation. In this role, you will be responsible for reviewing, quality-assuring, and editing Permanent & Stationary (P&S) and supplemental reports to ensure they are complete, internally consistent, accurately documented, and ready for final physician sign-off.
Key Responsibilities:
P&S & Supplemental Report QA (Primary):

• Verify demographics, claim details, dates of injury, and body parts across report sections.

• Cross-check injury history, objective exam findings, diagnoses, and narrative descriptions for internal consistency.

• Review supplemental reports to ensure they address new medical records, questions, or legal issues.

• Identify and flag missing, conflicting, or incomplete report sections prior to finalization.

• Proofread medical terminology, spelling, grammar, and ensure adherence to physician formatting templates.

WC Med-Legal Content Auditing:

• Review core components of P&S reports, including P&S/MMI status, mechanism of injury, accepted vs. disputed body parts, subjective/objective findings, diagnoses, WPI, apportionment, work restrictions, and future medical care.

• Ensure Whole Person Impairment (WPI) and apportionment entries are clearly documented and consistent.

Medical Records Review & Case Prep:

• Prepare case fact sheets prior to upcoming examinations.

• Compare report statements against supporting clinical records (dates, treatment history, diagnostics).

• Track and request missing medical records, maintain report templates/checklists, and document required corrections.

Requirements
Direct experience reviewing or editing Workers' Compensation med-legal reports (P&S, MMI, or impairment reports from any state).
Strong command of WC terminology, including P&S/MMI, WPI, apportionment, causation, work restrictions, and future medical care.
Working knowledge of the AMA Guides (5th Edition preferred).
Proven track record in clinical documentation review and medical records comparison.
Exceptional written English, medical proofreading skills, attention to detail, and independence.
Please note that this is a full-time contractor position (40 hours per week) with a starting pay rate of $6 per hour depending on skillset and experience. The schedule is Monday through Friday, 8am-5pm PST.

title: Regional Field Marketing, India
description:
ClickHouse is hiring for our Regional Field Marketing, India role to lead our regional field marketing strategy in India. This is a foundational role responsible for building awareness, generating pipeline, and accelerating revenue in the region.

In this role, your mission will be to define and scale the India regional field marketing engine. You will own the regional field marketing strategy, partner closely with India sales leadership, and adapt global campaigns to the needs of the India market. You will be measured on enterprise pipeline and self-service revenue (MRR), working across both our self-serve product-led motion and our sales-led enterprise motion.

What You Will Be Doing

- Own the India regional field marketing strategy, annual plan, and budget, aligning field programs to regional pipeline and revenue targets with sales leadership.

- Act as the marketing counterpart to India sales leadership, joining regional forecasting, QBRs, and account planning so marketing investment maps to sales priorities.

- Partner with demand generation and growth to build programs for strategic verticals and AI-native sales teams, and to convert self-serve usage into commercial pipeline and expansion revenue.

- Build an integrated regional program mix spanning first-party hosted events, third-party conferences, virtual events, ABM plays, digital advertising, and partner marketing.

- Adapt global campaigns, messaging, and content for the India market.

- Establish scalable processes for campaign planning, lead management, and follow-up with marketing operations and global demand generation, so every program has a clear path from engagement to pipeline. Report on pipeline generated and influenced revenue.

- Identify emerging opportunities across India, make the case for new investment in geographies, verticals, or channels, and represent the region in global planning cycles.

What You Bring Along

- 10+ years of experience in field, regional, or integrated marketing within the database, data analytics, infrastructure, or developer tooling space

- Deep experience marketing in India

- Demonstrated success owning a pipeline number and driving measurable revenue impact through regional marketing programs

- Proven ability to partner with sales leadership at the VP level

- Experience working in a remote-first, globally distributed organization, collaborating across time zones

- Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by building in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

- Able to travel at least 2 times per month across India

 

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

- Global Gatherings - We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

title: Okta Support Engineer
description:
This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible. Koniag IT Systems, LLC, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an Okta Support Engineer with a Secret Security clearance to support KITS and our government customer. The position is remote. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement. Koniag IT Systems, LLC, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an experienced ICAM Okta Support Engineer to join a team supporting Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) solutions for our government customers. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled professional with a strong background in identity and access management technologies, particularly within the Okta platform, and is passionate about delivering secure and reliable solutions in a federal environment.
The ICAM Okta Support Engineer will provide technical support, configuration, administration, and maintenance of Okta-based Identity, Credential, and Access Management solutions in a federal government environment. The engineer will work closely with security teams, system administrators, and government stakeholders to ensure integrity, availability, and security of identity and access management systems.
Principal responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

• Provide day-to-day administration, configuration, and support of the Okta platform, including user lifecycle management, application integrations, and authentication policies.

• Troubleshoot and resolve ICAM-related incidents, service requests, and problems in a timely manner, adhering to established SLAs.

• Configure and maintain Okta features including Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Universal Directory, Lifecycle Management, and API Access Management.

• Integrate Okta with enterprise applications, directories, and third-party services using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC) protocols.

• Support the onboarding and offboarding of users and applications within the Okta environment.

• Monitor system health, review logs, and proactively identify and address potential issues within the ICAM ecosystem.

• Collaborate with security and compliance teams to ensure IAM configurations meet federal security standards and frameworks, including NIST guidelines and Zero Trust principles.

• Assist in the development and maintenance of technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and runbooks related to ICAM and Okta operations.

• Participate in change management processes, including planning, testing, and implementing changes to the Okta environment.

• Support audits and compliance reviews by providing relevant access reports and configuration documentation.

• Work with cross-functional teams to evaluate and implement new Okta features and capabilities that align with mission requirements.

• Provide Tier 2/Tier 3 support for escalated identity and access management issues.

Education and Experience:
Required:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field from an accredited college or university; equivalent work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

• 3+ years of hands-on experience administering and supporting Okta or a comparable Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform.

• Active Secret Clearance required.

• Relevant Okta certification(s) required (e.g., Okta Certified Administrator, Okta Certified Professional, or Okta Certified Consultant).

Required Skills and Competencies:

• Exceptional communication skills in English - both written and oral - with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Hands-on experience administering the Okta platform, including SSO, MFA, Unive

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Maritime Division is transforming American sea power to meet the defining national security challenges of our era and secure our future of maritime dominance.

We are scaling at a historic pace, anchored by Arsenal-2, our new software-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base.

Arsenal-2 is purpose-built to break long-standing industrial bottlenecks and scale production of critical components for the Navy's Virginia-class attack submarines to support fleet requirements. At the same time, it will build the industrial muscle to field our next-generation AUVs at scale.

We aren't waiting for the new shipyard to be completed. The work on this transformation starts right now, with development inside our new 160,000 square foot Proto-Factory in Orange County, California, where the team is already laying the foundation. As the prototyping hub for Arsenal-2, this facility gives us a multi-year head start, proving out the advanced manufacturing methods, digital workflows, and quality systems that will scale across our broader shipyard network.

In Anduril's Maritime Division, we are actively building America's next decisive advantage at sea-and this is the moment to join us.

ABOUT THE JOB

You will own energy storage system design for a maritime autonomous vehicle. Reporting to the Vehicle Systems Lead, you will drive cell selection, module design, thermal management, and pressure-rated packaging for battery systems that must deliver ultra-long-range endurance under pressure.

Your spectrum of support will be diverse in nature and require you to leverage your technical expertise as well as leadership skills to set objectives, build cross-functional teams, and rapidly drive to completion. The ability to leverage your intuition and prior experience will be key in making sure the right design, analysis, and test steps are completed to ensure success. The ideal candidate will leverage their experience executing and successfully completing prior highly optimized multi-disciplinary projects.

• Own energy storage architecture: cell chemistry selection, module design, and pack integration

• Design pressure-rated battery enclosures for full-ocean-depth operation

• Perform battery sizing, energy budget analysis, and cycle life modeling

• Drive thermal management design for safe operation across environmental conditions

• Define charging profiles and integration with external charging interfaces

• Interface with energy distribution, structural, and production teams

• Support prototype builds, testing, and design-for-manufacturability reviews

• Contribute to safety analysis for energy storage systems

• Travel up to 25% to test sites and vendor facilities

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent

• 5+ years of experience in battery system design, energy storage, or power electronics

• Experience with lithium-ion or equivalent high-energy-density battery systems

• Familiarity with battery management systems and thermal management

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance

title: Director of Product, AI Labs
description:
About airSlate

airSlate is a global SaaS technology company that develops no-code workflow automation, electronic signature, and document management solutions. Our award-winning products - Sign Now, pdfFiller, DocHub, altaFlow, Instapage, and US Legal Forms - serve over hundreds of millions of users and more than one million customers worldwide, helping organizations of every size digitize processes, improve efficiency, and transform how they work.
We’re in an exciting phase of growth and transformation, with teammates in more than 20 countries across three continents and main hubs in the United States, Poland, Ukraine and Philippines .
At airSlate , we’re building value for customers and a culture where growth and innovation go hand in hand. We’re looking for people eager to shape products, scale a company, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.
Who we are

airSlate built a $1800M+ business serving dozens of millions of users across pdfFiller, SignNow, DocHub, AltaFlow and Instapage, on the back of a proprietary long-tail marketing engine. AI is now disrupting the core of that business and, at the same time, opening up a much bigger opportunity: solving the underlying business outcome end to end - draft, sign, track, invoice, collect - not just the document step.
The opportunity
We're running the company as two deliberately separate efforts. Our legacy portfolio - pdfFiller, DocHub, SignNow, AltaFlow - which we're optimizing for defensible 3-5 year revenue to fund what's next. AI Labs: a structurally separate, AI-native business we're building from scratch, targeting $20-50M of new topline in 2-3 years.
AI Labs is already proving the model works. BizDraft - AI-drafted agreements for SMBs - has shipped and is our learning vehicle for running a ~90% AI-driven product end to end. Ordinum, an AI compliance agent for regulated SMBs, is in development. BizPulse, which reconstructs a small business's financial and operational reality straight from its inbox, is in a controlled experiment. Alongside the products, AI Labs has rebuilt the pdfFiller editor from scratch (5x faster, 10x smaller) and stood up internal AI systems - Discovery Engine, document-based segmentation, Synthetic Users, Zero Reporting - that are starting to change how the rest of the company works.
We need a product leader to take AI Labs from "proving the model" to a real business.
The role
You'll own product for AI Labs: strategy, roadmap, and definition across our AI-native product line (BizDraft, Ordinum, BizPulse, and whatever comes next). You lead a small group of Product Owners, and will work in tight lockstep with AI Labs' engineering leadership, who own the build team.
A small go-to-market team - one product marketer and one marketer - supports AI Labs today, and you'll work closely with them on market analysis, idea generation, triage and prioritization, positioning, and launch.
What you'll do:

• Own product strategy and roadmap for AI Labs, targeting $20-50M in new AI-native topline over 2-3 years

• Scale BizDraft post-launch, drive Ordinum and BizPulse through to go/no-go for launch

• Identify, size and prioritize 2 to 5 more high-potential projects, based on established customer needs and a potential competitive advantage for airSlate

• Hire and lead a very small team of AI-native, 0-to-1 Product Owners, each owning the build out of a specific product against the prioritized ideas, and developing it based on customer and market feedback

• Develop a working understanding of our existing products (pdfFiller, SignNow, DocHub, AltaFlow) and their customers, to surface needs and use cases AI Labs can act on - some of which may be better rolled into an existing product as a feature rather than launched as a standalone AI Labs product

• Define product requirements and priorities with the precision AI-driven execution demands

• Partner closely with AI Labs' engineering lead on sequencing and trade-offs, without owning the engineering team directly

description:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the Role

As we have continued to expand, we want to meet the industry where it gathers. As a Field Marketer, you'll be Clipboard's face on the conference circuit in 2027. That means attending nearly every major Post Acute conference, trade show, and association event in the country. You'll work the floor, start conversations with agency owners and operators, qualify opportunities, and turn those conversations into pipeline and revenue.

This is a travel role. Expect to be on the road about 80% of the time. If living out of a suitcase sounds like a burden, this isn't the right role for you. If it sounds like an adventure and a big advantage in building a sales career, read on.

What You’ll Do

- Represent Clipboard in person at national, regional, and state conferences, trade shows, and industry events.

- Prospect aggressively before, during, and after every event: research attendee lists, book meetings ahead of time, and work the floor to start new conversations.

- Run discovery with Agency Owners, Administrators, Directors of Nursing, Clinical Managers, Directors of Operations, and staffing and recruiting leaders.

- Qualify opportunities and move them forward. Book next steps, convert interest into an active pipeline, and push deals toward close with the broader sales team.

- Work fluently across the organization within the sales team to ensure smooth handoffs after events.

- Share what you learn on the ground (customer pain points, competitor positioning, which events are worth our time) with sales, marketing, product and leadership.

Who You Are

- Willingness to travel about 80% of the time (roughly 40 weeks per year), including frequent overnight and multi-day trips.

- You must live in a major metro area within easy reach of a major airport.

- A valid driver's license and the ability to travel domestically without restriction.

- Comfortable working remotely and independently between events.

- Strong communication and relationship-building skills across clinical and business audiences.

- Curiosity, persistence, and a bias for action.

- Organization and autonomy in managing your own schedule and pipeline.

Our Interview Process

1. Case Study

2. Case Study Interview

3. Background Interview

4. Culture Interview (In Person)

5. Executive Chat

Because this role will primarily be in person at events, our culture round is held in person, and Clipboard covers all travel expenses. We want to see how you show up, and we want you to meet the team you'd be working with.

What We Offer

- Competitive base salary + uncapped commission

- Insurance benefits and 401k options

- Unlimited PTO and flexible holidays

- Mileage reimbursement or travel stipend for field work

- Remote flexibility when not in the field

- Clear growth path

Quick Note on Scammers:

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here https://forms.gle/SyGaxHFbon7Hg9fW6.

We're backed by over $50M USD from QED, Blackbird, and Square Peg, with backing from operators like Claire Hughes Johnson (ex-Stripe COO) and Cristina Cordova (Linear COO), plus founders of Canva, Atlassian, and Airwallex. Our customers include some of the largest telehealth, fintech, and marketplace companies in the US and Australia - many handling over a million support tickets a year. The problems are real, the scale is real, and the work matters.

If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact - this is the place.

About the role

Our Forward Deployed team works between our customers and our product. They take a customer’s whole support operation (the tickets, the systems, the policies) and turn it into AI agents that resolve real customer queries in production.

As an FDE intern, you’ll be part of that team from day one, not on a side project. The workflows you build will go live and handle real conversations for some of the largest fintech and healthtech companies in the US and Australia. You’ll have close support from the team and real ownership of the work you take on.

Day to day, you’ll:

title: Risk and Change Manager - Alpha Delivery PMO
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

- Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

YOUR IMPACT

You keep Alpha's cost and schedule baselines honest against each other. Without a credible risk register and change process, changes slip into the program outside any controlled path, the IMS and cost forecast quietly drift apart, and a gate review surprises leadership with numbers nobody signed off on. Your job is to prevent that by making risk and change management a live, trusted function from the earliest stage of delivery, rather than something bolted on once problems have compounded.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Establish and maintain the Alpha risk register across infrastructure, manufacturing and machine workstreams, facilitating structured risk identification, assessment and assignment of mitigation owners

- Own the change control process end to end, from intake and schedule, cost and technical impact assessment through to approval routing and the change log, working closely with the Cost Controller and Programme Schedule Manager so all baselines reflect the same accepted changes

- Prepare risk-adjusted inputs for release gate decisions, including quantified schedule and cost exposure and mitigation status

- Run regular risk reviews with workstream owners and escalate emerging risks early, before they reach senior leadership as surprises

- Build risk and change governance standards that scale as Alpha and Stellaris grow in parallel, with different partners and delivery models

- Support the PMO's wider reporting cadence alongside the PMO Analyst/Coordinator

WHO YOU ARE

- Experienced in risk and change management on major capital programs in energy, industrial, research infrastructure or similarly complex multi-discipline settings

- Able to build a risk and change framework from scratch, not just administer an inherited one; you know what good governance looks like before it exists

description:

As part of the GE Aerospace Digital Technology organization supporting the Defense & Systems (D&S) business, the Director, Program Management owns delivery across the Defense and Systems Customer Experience (DSCX) portfolio. This is a people-leadership role accountable for on-time delivery, program operating rhythms, dependency and risk management, and the scope, schedule, and cost tradeoffs for every program. This person will lead a team of program and project managers, set the delivery standard, and own the $25+MM CX budget in partnership with Finance and Business Operations. This person will be the single point of accountability for predictable execution and for escalating early when a dependency or decision threatens delivery. Job Description
Why This Role Exists
DSCX owns 30+ digital products for Defense & Systems. Today our technical product managers wear three hats for their products: product management, project management, and operations. We are dividing that load across three dedicated functions, and this role will build out the program management discipline, starting with on-time delivery across the portfolio. This role is planned to have 4-6 direct reports, program and project managers, and owns the $25+MM CX budget with Finance and Business Operations. Your charge is to build standard operating rhythms and artifacts, and then coach and train your team to hold them. You should be experienced with AI and know where it creates opportunity to expand what the team can deliver.

Environment
The DSCX portfolio runs primarily on AWS, Palantir Foundry, or through SaaS based 3rd party solutions, with on-premise implementations supported for customers whose data sensitivity requires it. Delivery runs through Rally and Microsoft Teams and ServiceNow is our system of record for incidents, change, and defect management. The portfolio carries a $25+MM annual budget across the product lines.

Roles and Responsibilities

GDIT is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer (AWS / Windows) to join our National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) team in Rockville, MD. You will use Terraform to create, modify, and automate the AWS infrastructure that hosts NIAID's Windows-based scientific and business applications.

Our ideal candidate is a senior engineer who manages infrastructure through code. You have built and maintained AWS environments in Terraform, delivered changes through Git-based pipelines, and automated the manual work that usually comes with hosting Windows applications. You are as comfortable writing a Terraform module as you are troubleshooting an application running on IIS.
As a senior member of our Cloud DevOps team, you will run and improve our existing AWS platform and help move the remaining on-prem Windows workloads into AWS. You will work closely with application owners, software developers, and security teams, own your work from design through operations, and help shape how the team builds and ships infrastructure. After-hours work is occasionally required for planned maintenance or for troubleshooting service-impacting outages.

HOW A SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

• Create, modify, and maintain AWS infrastructure and services in Terraform. That means writing new modules and configurations, extending existing ones, and managing state across environments.

• Deliver infrastructure changes through GitHub Actions and AWS CodeBuild pipelines, so every change is reviewed in a pull request, planned, and applied the same way every time.

• Build and maintain the AWS environment that hosts Windows Server and IIS applications running .NET, including EC2, load balancers, AWS WAF, Route 53, IAM, and TLS certificates, all defined in Terraform.

• Migrate on-prem Windows applications into AWS and improve them once they land, including moving applications into containers on Amazon ECS where it makes sense.

• Automate routine operational work such as certificate renewal, service account credential rotation, patching, and service restarts, using Terraform, PowerShell, and AWS Systems Manager. Where possible, turn these tasks into self-service options for application owners.

• Troubleshoot problems across the application and infrastructure layers (IIS, .NET, networking, and AWS services) and fix the root cause in code rather than by hand.

• Build and tune monitoring with Amazon CloudWatch and native AWS observability services, including metrics, logs, alarms, dashboards, and the CloudWatch agent on Windows servers, all defined in Terraform. Set service level objectives and alerts so the team hears about real problems before users do.

• Work with the security team to remediate vulnerabilities and apply hardening standards to Windows servers and AWS resources.

• Review teammates' Terraform and pipeline changes, share what works, and help shape the team's standards for infrastructure as code and deployments.

Required Experience:

• BA/BS and 7+ years of related IT experience, or equivalent experience. This must include 3+ years of hands-on DevOps or cloud engineering in AWS supporting production workloads.

• 3+ years using Terraform to create, modify, and automate AWS infrastructure, including writing modules, safely changing existing configurations, and managing remote state.

• Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines that deploy infrastructure changes, using GitHub Actions, AWS CodeBuild, or similar tools

title: Senior Stack Scientist
description: Senior Stack Scientist About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy. As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance. Key Responsibilities Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks. Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles. Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance. Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams. Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies. Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

title: Senior Manager, Customer Experience Strategy & Operations
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp believes that AI-powered CX organizations are the future and we are racing to build the best one in the world. Our goal is for our team to work hand in hand with AI agents to drive superlative customer outcomes and the highest-velocity AI improvement engine in the business.

This role will own the strategy and ops teams that are making that transition a reality while still delivering 24/7/365 support for our 85,000+ customers every day. You will work with the Head of CX to set the goals, measure what matters, and build the systems and programs that push the team forward. You’ll manage a small and mighty team across Business Operations, CX Analytics, Workforce Management, Learning & Development, and CX AI Operations to accomplish your goals.

We believe every CX frontline specialist has a role to play driving forward the performance of our AI agents - it is not work reserved for a dedicated AI team. Each specialist needs to be trained, coached, scheduled, and rewarded for continuous work of closing AI learning loops, ensuring AI escalations get resolved, and obsessing about how our customers are actually being served.

You'll do this while running a global support operation that has to be excellent today. Once we nail the model in CX, there will be momentum to help other operations teams adopt it.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Set the goals and measure what matters. Work with the Head of CX and senior CX managers to set org-wide goals, decide how we measure progress, and deliver the programs and projects that enable that strategy to flourish.

- Define how specialists and AI agents work together. Build the roles, workflows, and expectations that let specialists and AI agents serve customers as one team.

- Change what we reward. Rebuild goals, incentives, and performance management so specialists get credit for closing AI learning loops, getting AI escalations resolved, and improving how customers are actually served, alongside traditional frontline performance.

- Own global schedules, capacity, and quality. Plan coverage for 24/7/365, multi-tier, global support that holds a high bar for customers of all shapes and sizes.

- Build the training model for the new work. Both new and tenured specialists need to investigate hard issues, judge agent behavior, and contribute fixes, while still developing a deep understanding Ramp’s complex financial products. L&D should make them good at all of it.

- Turn AI progress into operating change. Know what our Investigative Copilot (specialist-facing) and AskRamp (fully agentic) can do and how well they do it. When that moves, change staffing, workflows, training, and expectations to match.

- Build and own the voice of the CX specialist to Product and Engineering. Use CX data to show technical teams where agents succeed and where they struggle, and work with them directly on tooling, prompts, and agent behavior. They own the roadmap; you make sure CX's evidence shapes it.

- Build a small, strong team. Develop and grow leaders across Business Operations,

title: Emerging Enterprise Account Executive, Healthcare
description:
Our sales team is committed to customer centricity by focusing on understanding and meeting the unique needs and aspirations of each customer. We prioritize delivering exceptional value through tailored solutions and strategic partnerships. By fostering a collaborative environment across all go-to-market functions, we engage in value selling, ensuring that every interaction enhances and maximizes the customer experience. We work closely with marketing, product, and customer success teams to ensure alignment and continuous improvement. Together, we identify and overcome technical, educational, and competitive challenges, driving long-term growth and customer satisfaction.

We’re seeking a high-energy, high-motor Account Executive to own a large book of mid-market and enterprise accounts within our healthcare segment. You’ll win new logos through disciplined prospecting while growing an install base of paying customers. This is a fast-moving seat: you’ll close a high volume of deals every quarter, from quick transactional wins to larger enterprise agreements, and you’ll learn to build the bigger deals over time. Experience in healthcare or other regulated industries is a plus, but it isn’t required.

This role is based in our New York, San Francisco, or Chicago office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you’re interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

• Own and grow a large book of accounts, balancing new logo acquisition with expansion and renewals in a base of paying customers.

• Build a smart territory plan: prioritize accounts by spend, expansion potential, product usage, and white space, and know where to move fast and where to go deep.

• Drive consistent outbound activity across email, calls, and other channels, and use that activity to create a steady pipeline.

• Manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation and close, at high velocity and across deal sizes.

• Grow smaller deals into larger, more strategic enterprise agreements over time.

• Work through security, legal, privacy, and compliance reviews with customers in regulated environments.

• Partner with Solutions Engineering, Sales Development, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Executive Sponsors to win deals and drive adoption.

• Build trust with stakeholders at all levels, from day-to-day users to IT, security, and executive leaders.

About you

• 5+ years of experience in a B2B closing sales role, with experience managing a large book of accounts in mid-market and/or enterprise sales. SaaS experience is a plus.

• A high motor and a hunter mentality, with a disciplined approach to prospecting and a clear plan for how you cover a large territory week after week.

• Comfortable in a transactional, high-volume environment, closing a range of deal sizes, and motivated to grow into larger deals.

• A track record of high and consistent quota attainment.

• Skilled at multi-threading and building trust with stakeholders across all levels of an organization.

• Familiarity with working through security and compliance reviews in regulated markets (for example healthcare, financial services, or life sciences) is a plus. Healthcare experience is a bonus, not a requirement.

• A self-starter who thrives on continuous learning and professional growth.

• Curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to use them to work smarter.

At Asana, we’re committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you’re interested in this role and don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

title: Senior Clinical Data Manager
description:
Position Summary: 

The Senior Clinical Data Manager is responsible and manages all aspects of the clinical trial data management process from study start up to post database lock for assigned projects. Standard Operating Procedures / Work Instructions (SOPs/WIs); regulatory directives; study specific plans and guidelines will be followed. This position will also oversee and/or perform database development and testing. 

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

• Primary Data Management (DM) contact (Lead DM role) for assigned clinical project(s) / program(s), ensuring that there is back-up, continuity, responsiveness, and that tasks are performed in a timely manner. May support another Lead DM as a back-up and/or team member. May include DM oversight of sponsor programs.

• Oversee project data entry process including development of data entry guidelines, training, data entry quality and resourcing

• May perform quality control of data entry

• Provide input, assesses and manage timelines. Ensure that clinical data management deadlines are met with quality. Assess resource needs for assigned projects, as needed.

• Develop CRF specifications from the clinical study protocol and coordinate the review/feedback from all stakeholders

• May assist in building clinical databases

• Conduct database build UAT and maintain quality controlled database build documentation. Oversee overall quality of the clinical database.

• May specify requirements for all edit check types e.g. electronic, manual data review, edit checks, etc. Oversee development of the edit check specifications and manual data review specifications

• Responsible for creating, revising, appropriate versioning and maintaining data management documentation. Oversee completeness of data management documentation for the Trial Master File.

• Train clinical research personnel on the study specific CRF, EDC, and other project related items as needed.

• Review and query clinical trial data according to the Data Management Plan

• Perform line listing data review based on the guidance provided by the sponsor and/or Lead DM

• Run patient and study level status and metric reporting

• Perform medical coding of medical terms relative to each other in order to ensure medical logic and consistency

• Coordinate SAE/AE reconciliation

• Liaises with third-party vendors such as external data and EDC vendors in a projectmanager capacity in support of timelines and data-related deliverables

• May assist with SAS programming and quality control of SAS programs used in the Data Management department

• Identify and troubleshoot operational problems, issues, obstacles, and barriers for studies based on metrics data, audit reports, and input from project team members and other stakeholders

• May assist in reviewing and providing feedback on protocols, Statistical Analysis Plans (SAP) and Clinical Study Reports (CSRs), if required by the project

• Participate in the development and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and corresponding process documentation related to data management and database management activities

• May attend strategy meetings, bid defense prep meetings, bid defenses, capability presentations, potential client engagement meetings

• May review Request for Proposals (RFP), proposals, provide project estimates

• Provide leadership for cross-functional and organization-wide initiatives, where applicable

• Trains and ensures that all data management project team members have been sufficiently trained

• Communicate with study sponsors, vendors and project teams as needed regarding data, database or other relevant project issues

Security and Compliance

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

Relay makes millions of dynamic, interconnected decisions across its network every day, and each one shapes the experience of the thousands of couriers who work with us. Knowing what any one of those decisions actually did is hard: couriers interfere with each other, effects vary from person to person, and the outcomes that matter compound over time.

Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered. You'll lead causal inference at Relay from the start.

CAUSAL INFERENCE HIGHLIGHTS

- A live, two-sided marketplace to experiment in, with every decision logged across millions of parcels.

- Interference between couriers, heterogeneous effects and long-term outcomes are the norm here, not the exception.

- Four marketplaces, each with its own app and its own economics.

- Your insights and models feed straight into Relay's network-wide optimisation.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Research Scientist at Relay, you'll:

- Set the standard for causal inference at Relay.

- Measure how our decisions affect each courier, today and over time.

- Shape how Relay experiments across a live, two-sided marketplace.

- Adapt advanced techniques across causal inference, statistics and machine learning to Relay's problems, and see them through to production.

- Partner with Operational Research to embed your insights and models into Relay's network-wide optimisation, and help build our research culture and voice in the tech community.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Bring deep expertise in causal inference, experimentation and machine learning, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.

- Come from statistics, an experimental science such as biology or psychology, or quantitative research.

- Have applied advanced techniques to real marketplaces or products, and owned the outcome.

- Think in mechanisms, and let evidence guide decisions.

- Are energised by open, interconnected problems, and know how to find the signal.

- Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

title: Product Quality Engineer, Dive-XL

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM 

Anduril is fielding the next generation of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of seabed exploration. Anduril has brought to the market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth platform, and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from "large" to "extra-large" vehicle sizes. Today, Anduril is executing on multi-million-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.

ABOUT THE JOB 

We are looking for a Product Quality Engineer to join our new team in Quonset, RI. In this role, you will be responsible for working inside and outside the organization to define, develop, and execute processes that deliver for AUV integration. You will help drive Anduril's internal quality management system to meet AS9100 customer requirements and scaling into our new facility for a new production line being brought into the facility for our Dive-XL. You will partner across the product development organization, production organization, and field operations organizations. This role will be dynamic and full of new engagement, challenges, and opportunities. If you are someone who has passion for the quality of their work, is hands-on with engineering, production, and vendors, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.

This role focuses on integration for the AUV and all the sub-systems. The right person for this role will have the knowledge of manufacturing, integration, sub-system performance criteria, and metrology that builds confidence with defense customers. If you are someone who loves to build world-class Quality processes, work hands-on, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Execute the vision of the Product Quality Engineering Manager to support the quality of the integration process for components such as underwater sensors/equipment, PCBAs, cables, wiring harness, actuators, machined parts and structures, etc. Conduct audits and inspections to ensure compliance with quality standards.

• Work cross-functionally to define and execute the product build and inspection requirements to meet our customer quality requirements.

• Lead the non-conformance review (NCR) process for vehicle integration: Identify defects and flaws in vehicle and subsystem assembly, identify issues and implement corrective actions, and support the usage of coordinate systems, envelopes, and interfaces for system integration.

• Lead the Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) process for integration, incident management system and Material Review Board (MRB) activities for aircraft programs, while owning containments for prototype builds and production.

• Develop incoming inspection control plans in collaboration with design engineering to define and verify Critical to Function (CTF) and Critical to Quality (CTQ) dimensions and characteristics.

• Collaborate with production system equivalents at other sites to standardize processes, methods, and techniques used to execute day-to-day job responsibilities.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or similar technical field.

• Experience in Engineer
